description: A shell script for testing basic subproject functionality in a Git-based project. It includes setting up superprojects and subprojects, performing commits, diffs, cloning, and renaming subprojects, as well as various test expectations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with the given description and commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that the command exits with the specified code.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or strings and checks for equality.
